"""Animate the observed candle flame while retaining the locked-off scene."""
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image
from scipy.ndimage import map_coordinates, gaussian_filter
import artifact_io

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent


def generate():
    source = np.asarray(Image.open(ROOT / 'first_frame.png').convert('RGB'), dtype=np.uint8)
    image = source.astype(np.float64)
    yy, xx = np.mgrid[:144, :256].astype(float)

    # Recover the smoothly shaded wall beneath the small luminous area from
    # the wall on either side. All other photographic material is untouched.
    def features(x, y):
        x = (x - 132.) / 35.
        y = (y - 20.) / 25.
        return np.stack([np.ones_like(x), x, y, x*x, x*y, y*y, x*x*x], axis=-1)

    sample = (yy <= 44) & (((xx >= 91) & (xx <= 107)) | ((xx >= 154) & (xx <= 171)))
    matrix = features(xx[sample], yy[sample])
    coef = np.linalg.lstsq(matrix, image[sample], rcond=None)[0]
    wall = features(xx, yy) @ coef
    # Feather the recovery well outside the bright core. At the wick the
    # deformation becomes zero, keeping the light firmly attached to the wax.
    left = np.clip((xx - 101.) / 10., 0., 1.)
    right = np.clip((158. - xx) / 10., 0., 1.)
    region = left * right * (yy <= 30)
    light = (image - wall) * region[..., None]
    still = image - light

    frames = [source.copy()]
    for i in range(1, 20):
        t = i / 4.
        # Several weak, independent air-current components change flame height,
        # width and curvature. No camera movement or new scene elements.
        height = 1 + .083 * np.sin(2*np.pi*1.13*t) + .045 * np.sin(2*np.pi*.57*t) + .025 * np.sin(2*np.pi*1.79*t)
        width = 1 + .09 * np.sin(2*np.pi*.91*t) + .035 * np.sin(2*np.pi*1.61*t)
        lean = 1.55 * np.sin(2*np.pi*.73*t) + .55 * np.sin(2*np.pi*1.37*t)
        bend = .7 * np.sin(2*np.pi*.47*t)
        sy = 30. - (30. - yy) / height
        up = np.clip((30.-sy)/18., 0., 1.5)
        flex = lean * up**1.35 + bend*np.sin(up*np.pi)*up
        sx = 132. + (xx - 132. - flex) / (1 + (width-1)*np.clip(up*2, 0., 1.))
        # Retain the wick and the last two rows at their original position.
        anchored = np.clip((30.-yy)/3., 0., 1.)
        sy = yy + (sy-yy)*anchored
        sx = xx + (sx-xx)*anchored
        warped = np.stack([map_coordinates(light[..., c], [sy, sx], order=1, mode='constant', cval=0., prefilter=False)
                           for c in range(3)], axis=-1)
        gain = 1 + .045*np.sin(2*np.pi*1.31*t) + .022*np.sin(2*np.pi*.63*t)
        # The white-hot core remains nearly white; surrounding orange radiance
        # responds a little more to variations in the burning gas volume.
        hot = np.clip((warped[..., 1]-65.)/50., 0., 1.)
        local_gain = 1 + (gain-1)*(1-.5*hot)
        local_gain = 1 + (local_gain-1)*anchored
        frame = still + warped*local_gain[..., None]
        # A very small corresponding warm reflection on the red candle top.
        reflection = np.exp(-((xx-132.)/7.)**4) * np.exp(-((yy-35.)/9.)**2) * (yy >= 31) * (yy <= 57)
        frame += reflection[...,None] * np.array([22., 9., 3.]) * (gain-1)
        frames.append(np.clip(np.rint(frame), 0, 255).astype(np.uint8))
    return np.stack(frames)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    frames = generate()
    assert np.array_equal(frames[0], np.asarray(Image.open(ROOT / 'first_frame.png').convert('RGB')))
    artifact_io.save(frames, ROOT)
